Not exploitable at this site: the envelope length is checked (or the tag is a fixed 16-byte slice of a length-checked blob) before setAuthTag, so a short tag cannot reach the decipher. The rule is syntactic; `{ authTagLength: 16 }` on createDecipheriv would be defence in depth.

Real hardening gap, not a false positive: the GCM tag is read from stored or transmitted data and its length is not enforced here, so a truncated tag would be accepted. Fix is `{ authTagLength: 16 }` on createDecipheriv; deferred out of the SAST change because it alters PHI-decrypt error behaviour and needs its own review and the module live suite. Fixing it makes this entry stale, which forces its removal.
